anisotropy.channels: R=direction X encoded 0..1 G=direction Y encoded 0..1 B=strength multiplier

mapContract.geometryLod: modeled yarn crop in inspector; mapped sheet elsewhere
mapContract.runtimeCompression: KTX2 Basis UASTC, mipmaps; retain uncompressed masters
mapContract.compressionQualityPolicy: reject visible normal block artifacts and lost coverage holes
mapContract.gltfImportPolicy: GLTFLoader owns flipY and texture transforms; never apply loose-texture overrides to imported glTF textures.
